name: Piercing Armament (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 15, Path of the Darkened Fortress

Benefit: The nightblade’s armament can pierce even the toughest of defenses. Creatures that make the saving throw to disbelieve the shadow armament still take full effect from the weapon for 1 round as if they had failed the Will save. This effect does not apply to real weapons enhanced by the nightblade’s dark enchantment art (if she has it).
